# Component and state contract

Contract `0.1.0` · design tokens `0.3.0` (proposal) · asset manifest `design-0.1.0` · wire protocol 1 at base commit `333c9e8`.

For every state of every component: the fact it may be drawn from, how it looks, and the live English words that say it. No state is told apart by color alone: every one has words, and most have an outline of their own as well. The hooks are the classes, ids and data attributes Frontend already produces
(`agent/frontend-motion-gallery` at `fccadf7`, as read by the Designer); a hook marked PROPOSED does not exist there yet and is listed in [frontend-handoff.md](frontend-handoff.md).

Nothing here is a rule. A state that would need a fact the audience views do not carry says so and points at an open decision in [README.md](README.md#open-decisions). A state that is exported and drawn by no rule says that too.

## The eight required states

Where each state the brief asks for appears. Each entry is a component and one of its states below, and every entry is a state the reference stylesheet really draws.

| State | Drawn as | What is not drawn, and why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **idle** | `action-card:available`, `action-card:available-waiting`, `seat-token:idle`, `button:idle`, `private-dock:closed` |  |
| **selection** | `action-card:targeting`, `button:pressed` | A ring around a chosen token is exported (token-emphasis:selected) and drawn by no reference rule yet: Frontend's confirmation step names the seat in words and shows no token. |
| **targeting** | `action-card:targeting`, `action-card:confirming`, `target-row:offered` | A ring for “may be chosen” is exported (token-emphasis:targetable) and drawn by no reference rule: protocol 1 has no server target list, and a ring would claim one (DSN-D03). |
| **pending** | `action-card:submitting`, `action-card:checking`, `action-card:unknown` |  |
| **registered** | `action-card:registered`, `action-card:registered-idle`, `resource-pip:registered` |  |
| **unavailable** | `action-card:unavailable`, `action-card:not-registered`, `button:not-active-yet` |  |
| **spent** | `action-card:was-registered` | Protocol 1 has no field that says a shot is spent (DSN-D02). The nearest authorized state is this device's own report that its registration is no longer pending, which lasts until the player presses Done or reloads; after that the card is whatever self.shotAvailable says. The struck-out pip is exported and drawn by no state. |
| **reconnect** | `shell:stale`, `banner-connection:stale`, `phase-timer:stale`, `action-card:available-paused` |  |

## Surfaces

| Surface | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| Table | The shared display. Public facts only. |
| Phone, public layer | A phone with its private sheet closed. The same on every phone whatever its role. |
| Phone, private sheet | Inside one seat's open private sheet. |

## Components

### Shell

`shell` · public · Table; Phone, public layer; Phone, private sheet

Hook: `.ms-shell[data-surface][data-screen][data-connection][data-motion]`

Assets: `pattern-hatch`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `live` | The client's own connection status is live. | No frame. | None needed. |
| `stale` | The client's own connection status is stale: the view shown is the last known one. _Nothing is greyed out: the last known state stays readable at full contrast._ | A hatched frame inside the edge of the main area; the countdown in a dashed outline. | The connection banner, and the actions notice inside an open sheet. |
| `connecting` | No view has arrived yet. _Frontend's screen; not restyled beyond tokens in this slice._ | The connecting panel in place of the match. | “Connecting to the match…” |
| `blocked` | The client reports an incompatible protocol or a failed integrity check. _Frontend's screen; not restyled beyond tokens in this slice._ | The recovery panel in place of the match. | Frontend's recovery copy. |

### Art bundles

`art-bundles` · public · Table; Phone, public layer; Phone, private sheet

Hook: `PROPOSED [data-art~="<bundle>"] on an ancestor of .ms-shell, set by the client`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `waiting` | A bundle's stylesheet has not loaded yet, or failed to load. | The complete skin without pictures: disc tokens with live numerals, chips with their words, plain inked panels. | Unchanged: every word is live text and none waits for a picture. |
| `arrived` | The bundle's one stylesheet has loaded. The client then adds the bundle's name to data-art, and not before. | The art rules of that bundle apply on top of the same skin. | Unchanged. |

A bundle is one stylesheet holding every picture in it as a custom property, so drawing something later never causes a request later. Every phone loads the same three bundles before its first match view; the table loads the public one. Forced colors keeps the skin without pictures.

Must not:

- Fetch a picture because of something a view says: which files a device asks for must tell an observer nothing.
- Set data-art before the stylesheet has loaded.
- Differ between seats.

### Phase caption

`phase-strip` · public · Table; Phone, public layer; Phone, private sheet

Hook: `.ms-phase > .ms-phase__labels[data-cue-at="phase"]`

Assets: `fx-panel-cap`, `fx-speed-lines`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `own-turn` | phase.kind is ORDINARY_TURN and activeSeatId is the viewer's own seat. | A paper caption box with an ink edge and an offset shadow. | “Round N” and “Your turn”. |
| `other-turn` | phase.kind is ORDINARY_TURN and activeSeatId is another seat, or the surface is the table. | The same box. | “Round N” and “Player N’s turn”. |
| `turn-unassigned` | phase.kind is ORDINARY_TURN and activeSeatId is null. | The same box. | “Round N” and “Turn in progress”. |
| `resolution` | phase.kind is ROUND_RESOLUTION. | The same box; the countdown is absent because the phase has no deadline. | “Round resolution” and “The round is being resolved.” |

Cues: [`cue-phase-change`](motion-storyboards.md#cue-phase-change), [`cue-round-transition`](motion-storyboards.md#cue-round-transition)

Sticky at the top edge of a phone, and an open private sheet stops below it, so the countdown stays in view. Where the screen is short for the reader's text (under 30em tall) the caption scrolls with the page instead, so that a caption which has wrapped cannot take the screen; an open sheet may then cover it, and the control that hides the sheet stays pinned at the sheet's top.

Must not:

- Say or color anything that depends on a role.
- Show a phase the protocol does not carry.

### Countdown

`phase-timer` · public · Table; Phone, public layer; Phone, private sheet

Hook: `.ms-timer[data-state][data-final] > .ms-timer__value`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `running` | A trusted estimate of phase.endsAt from server time. | Paper digits in a solid ink box; tabular figures. | The digits, and “N seconds remaining” for assistive technology. |
| `final-seconds` | The estimate is in its last seconds. | An extra outline around the box. No flash and no color change. | “N seconds left.” is spoken. |
| `expired` | The local estimate reached zero. Only the server advances the phase. | Ink digits on paper in a dashed outline. | “0:00” and “Waiting for phase update”. |
| `syncing` | The device has no trusted server time yet. | The same dashed outline. | “–:––” and “Syncing time with the server”. |
| `stale` | The client's own connection status is stale. | The last estimate in the dashed outline. | The connection banner says the state may be out of date. |
| `none` | phase.endsAt is null. | No box. | “This phase has no timer”. |

Must not:

- Be a cue anchor: no cue touches the countdown.
- Flash.

### Room vignette strip

`location-art` · public · Phone, public layer

Hook: `PROPOSED span.ms-location__art[data-location] inside .ms-location`

Assets: `board-room-a`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `present` | The viewer's own seats[].location has a vignette in the manifest and the public bundle has loaded. | The room's upper half as a 16:7 strip with an ink edge and a paper keyline. | None: it is decoration, hidden from assistive technology. The room name is the caption. |
| `missing` | No vignette exists for that location, or the public bundle has not loaded. | Not drawn. The panel is the caption and the list, as today. | The room name caption. |

Where a seat is, is a public fact, so the element is the same on every phone. The picture is in the public bundle, already loaded: nothing is fetched when a seat moves.

Must not:

- Carry text.
- Be the only way the location is told.

### Player token

`seat-token` · public · Table; Phone, public layer; Phone, private sheet

Hook: `.ms-token inside [data-seat] or [data-target-seat]`

Assets: `token-neutral`, `token-numeral`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | A seat in seats[] whose health is Healthy. | A ringed disc with a paper face and an ink numeral; a stand on the board. One numeral picture laid over one body. | “Player N” beside it. The numeral repeats the name and is hidden from assistive technology. |
| `injured` | seats[].health is Injured. | A cracked rim and a patch across the ring, on the badge and on the standee. | The health marker reads “Injured”. |
| `eliminated` | seats[].health is Eliminated. | Flat and hollow: a dashed ring, a duller face, no shadow, on the badge and on the standee. | The health marker reads “Eliminated”. |

Cues: [`cue-public-move`](motion-storyboards.md#cue-public-move)

Missing-asset fallback: A plain disc with the live numeral; a doubled ring for Injured, a dashed ring on duller paper for Eliminated. This is what is drawn until the public bundle has loaded.

In a target row the token is the idle badge whatever the seat's health: the row's words carry the public status.

Must not:

- Differ by role, faction, weapon, Code, Protection or any private fact.
- Carry a ring, a dim or any other emphasis on the table or outside the private sheet.
- Be the only way a health state is told.

### Private token emphasis

`token-emphasis` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `None yet. Would be drawn on .ms-token inside button.ms-target, inside .ms-private__panel only`

Assets: `token-emphasis`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetable` | PRIVATE. The seat is in the server's own target list where the protocol supplies one. Protocol 1 supplies none (DSN-D03). _Exported, and drawn by no reference rule yet._ | A dashed two-tone ring around the token. | The target row's name and public status. |
| `selected` | PRIVATE and local: the player chose this seat and nothing has been sent. _Exported, and drawn by no reference rule yet._ | A solid ring with ink edges around the token. | The confirmation prompt names the seat. |
| `unavailable` | PRIVATE. The seat is not in the server's target list. _Exported, and drawn by no reference rule yet._ | A darker ring and a duller face. | A reason only if the view supplies one; otherwise the seat is not offered. |

Three finished pictures with no rule that draws them. Protocol 1 gives the client no target list of the server's own, and Frontend's confirmation step shows no token, so nothing here is connected (DSN-D03).

Must not:

- Appear on the table display or outside the open private sheet.
- Mark a seat as allowed or not allowed from anything but the server's own target list.

### Roster

`roster-table` · public · Table

Hook: `.ms-roster .ms-table tr[data-seat][data-active] with td[data-cue-at]`

### Private dock and sheet

`private-dock` · public · Phone, public layer; Phone, private sheet

Hook: `section.ms-private[data-open] > #ms-private-toggle; PROPOSED class ms-private--docked`

Assets: `icon-private`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `closed` | Local: the default, and whenever the player closes it. | A bar at the bottom edge with a closed-eye control. | “Private” and “Show private information”. The reminder is shown where there is room and is always the control's description. On the narrowest phones and at large text the bar is its control and nothing else. |
| `open` | Local: the player opened it on this device and the page is in the foreground. | The sheet rises from the bar and stops below the phase caption where the screen is tall enough for the reader's text, and takes the whole screen where it is not. The control shows an open eye and stays pinned at the top of the sheet however far the cards are scrolled. | “Hide private information”. |
| `concealed` | The page went to the background. _Best-effort screen privacy, not screenshot protection._ | Closed. Nothing private is in the document. | As closed. |

Must not:

- Show a count, a badge, a dot or a highlight: whether a seat has something to do is private.
- Look different by role, turn or availability.
- Play a sound or vibrate.

### Role card

`role-card` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `.ms-role-card; PROPOSED children span.__art, __text, __name, __team, details.__more, __summary; PROPOSED custom properties --ms-role-art and --ms-team-accent set on the card by the client`

Assets: `card-officer`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compact` | PRIVATE. self.role of the player's own view, inside the open sheet, for a role that has a proposed card (the Officer only, in this slice). | A paper card: a 56 px thumbnail of the role illustration, the role name and the team. | The role name, the team in words, and “About this role”. |
| `expanded` | Local: the player opened “About this role”. | The illustration whole at 5:7 and the summary under it. | The proposed summary and limit lines (design/contract/copy.en.proposed.json). |
| `name-only` | PRIVATE. self.role for a role with no proposed card yet (eight of the nine), or before the role bundle has loaded. | A paper card holding the role name, as Frontend draws it today. No thumbnail, no team line. | The role name. |

The role name is never larger than the heading size, so it cannot be read across a table. The team is a fact of the role taken from the rule source (rules/overlays/player-modes-officer.json); no view field carries it. Its color swatch is decoration beside its word and exists only inside the sheet.

Must not:

- Fetch the dealt role's picture: every phone loads the whole role bundle as one stylesheet, whatever its role.
- Key a selector on the role: the client sets the picture and the swatch as custom properties on the card, inside the sheet.
- Appear, or leave any trace, outside the open sheet.
- Mention identifying another player: that step is archived.

### Action card (Shot)

`action-card` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `li.ms-card[data-action="shot"] > .ms-card__state[data-status][data-step][data-selected]`

Assets: `icon-action-shot`, `pattern-hatch`, `pip-resource`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `available` (idle) | PRIVATE. data-status available, with a control: self.shotAvailable is true, the view is current and unexpired, and it is this seat's own ordinary turn. | A paper card on an offset shadow; the status word in a solid ink box; one primary control. | “Available” and the “Choose a target” control. |
| `available-waiting` (idle) | PRIVATE. data-status available, with no control: self.shotAvailable is true, the view is current, and it is not this seat's ordinary turn. | The same card and the same solid status box. No control. | “Available” and “You can register a shot during your own turn.” |
| `available-paused` (reconnect) | PRIVATE. data-status available, with no control and no reason: self.shotAvailable is true and the view is stale or its phase clock has run out. | The same card with nothing under its status word; the notice above the cards in a dashed box. | “Available”, and above the cards “Actions are paused until the connection is restored.” |
| `targeting` (selection, targeting) | Local: the player picked the card up. Nothing has been sent. | The card lifted off its shadow with the focus-colored outline; target rows listed. | “Choosing a target”, the prompt and each target row. |
| `confirming` (targeting) | Local: a target is chosen. Nothing has been sent. | Still lifted; one primary control. | “Not sent yet”, “Register a shot at Player N?” and the consequence line. |
| `submitting` (pending) | The command is on its way. | Still lifted; a hatched band across the top that does not move. | “Submitting” and “Sending your shot to the server…” |
| `checking` (pending) | No usable answer yet; the client is asking for the receipt. | The same band. | “Checking” and what is being checked. |
| `unknown` (pending) | Automatic checking gave up. Nothing is assumed either way. | Still lifted; the status word in a double outline. | “Result unknown”, “Do not assume either way.” and “Check again”. |
| `registered` (registered) | data-status registered, data-step result: an accepted receipt for this device's own command, until the player presses Done. | The card back on its shadow; the status word is a stamp, turned 4 degrees in a doubled outline; the pip is dotted. | “Registered”, “Shot at Player N registered.” and “This is not a result.” Where this device no longer knows the target: “Your shot is registered.” |
| `registered-idle` (registered) | data-status registered, data-step idle: the seat's own view lists a command in ownPendingCommandIds, or this device registered one the view has not caught up with. | The same stamp on the card at rest; no control. | “Registered” and “Your shot at Player N is registered. It is resolved at the end of the round.” Where this device does not know the target: “A shot is registered. It is resolved at the end of the round.” |
| `was-registered` (spent) | This device saw its own registration, the view has since stopped listing it as pending, and the player has not yet pressed Done. _The nearest protocol 1 comes to spent. It lasts until Done or a reload; after that the card is whatever self.shotAvailable says. Nothing here says the shot was used: the view does not say why the command stopped being listed (DSN-D02)._ | Flat: duller paper, dashed edge, no shadow; a dashed stamp. No pip. | “Was registered” and “It is no longer waiting to be resolved. This is not a result.” |
| `unavailable` (unavailable) | data-status unavailable: self.shotAvailable is false and nothing is registered. | Flat: duller paper, dashed edge, no shadow; a dashed status box. Nothing under it. | “Not available”. No reason is given: the view supplies none. |
| `not-registered` (unavailable) | A rejection receipt, or a safe error for this device's own command. | A dashed status box on a normal card. | “Not registered” and the sentence for its code. |

Cues: [`cue-selection`](motion-storyboards.md#cue-selection), [`cue-registration`](motion-storyboards.md#cue-registration)

Every seat that is shown the card gets the same card. Only the server's availability and this device's own progress differ. The ten statuses are Frontend's; the three idle pictures of “available” differ only in what stands under the status word.

Must not:

- Show damage, a hit, a block or a result: registration is not an outcome.
- Explain a rejection or an unavailable state with a fact the view did not supply.
- Use a faction color: the card is not a Blue card.
- Start a second command while one is unresolved.
- Say a shot is used or spent: no field says so (DSN-D02).

### Status word

`action-status` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `.ms-card__status[data-cue-at="registration"]`

Assets: `pattern-halftone`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `word` | The card's own status. | One outline per status: solid, plain, double, dashed, or the turned stamp. | The status name. |

Cues: [`cue-registration`](motion-storyboards.md#cue-registration)

### Step line

`action-step` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `#ms-shot-step`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | The card's own step. | A bold line. Keyboard focus rests here, never on a control that would send a command. | The prompt, the progress sentence or the result sentence. |

### Resource pip

`resource-pip` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `PROPOSED .ms-card__pips > .ms-pip[data-pip] inside .ms-card__title`

Assets: `pip-resource`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `available` | PRIVATE. self.shotAvailable is true, the seat's view lists no pending command of its own, and no command of this card is unaccounted for on this device. | A solid cell. | “1 shot available” as its accessible name. |
| `registered` | PRIVATE. The seat's own view lists its pending command (ownPendingCommandIds), or this device holds its accepted receipt. | A dotted cell. | “1 shot registered”. |
| `none` | The view says neither, or a command of this card is unaccounted for (submitting, checking, unknown). | Not drawn. | None. |
| `spent` | NOT DRAWN in protocol 1. No field says a shot is spent (DSN-D02). _Exported for the day a field exists. No status of the card draws it._ | A dashed, empty cell struck through. | “Shot used”. |

Drawn from the seat's own view and nothing else. It repeats what the card's status word says. A count needs a field (DSN-D02). Without the player bundle it is not drawn at all.

Must not:

- Use a faction color.
- Appear outside the open sheet.

### Target row

`target-row` · private · Phone, private sheet

Hook: `button.ms-target[data-target-seat]`

Assets: `token-neutral`

| State | Drawn when | Told apart by | Words |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offered` | PRIVATE. The seat is offered as a target. In protocol 1 that is a provisional hint (same location), not the server's list (DSN-D03). | A full-width row: the token, the name, and the seat's public status in words. | “Player N” and its public status. |
| `none` | No seat is offered. | No rows. | “No other players are in your location.” |

The complete tap path. Dragging is never required. The token is the idle badge whatever the seat's health; the public status is in the row's words.

Must not:

- Describe a target by anything but its public status.
- Show why a seat is not offered unless the view supplies the reason.

| `not-active-yet` | Local: a control that only just appeared is inert for a moment, or the action is paused. | Flat: duller paper, dashed edge, no shadow. Still drawn, named and reachable. | Unchanged, with aria-disabled. |
| `focus` | Local: keyboard focus. | The focus ring, above everything: the focus color on dark ground; on paper, an ink ring with the focus color around it. | Unchanged. |
